## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type of Change

- [ ] New skill(s)
- [ ] Skill update
- [ ] Catalog or automation change
- [ ] Documentation/governance update
- [ ] CI/workflow update

## Validation

- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate_skills.py`
- [ ] `python3 scripts/sync_readme_catalog.py --check`

## Scope Check

- [ ] Change is focused and does not modify unrelated files.
- [ ] `skills/catalog.yaml` is updated for every added/renamed skill.
- [ ] README catalog is in sync.

## Notes

Anything reviewers should pay special attention to.
